nodes.label: System Orchestrator (Cortex Central)
nodes.title: System Orchestrator (Cortex Central)
nodes.description: The primary brain of the AI Cortex. Orchestrates specialized agents for Veeva Pulse, Rave Normalization, and Saama Strategic-Tactical sync. It utilizes "Neural Signal Decoding" to translate statistical flags into autonomous CRA intervention streams while maintaining a GxP-compliant "Unified Clinical Reality Layer".

nodes.label: Veeva "Cortex Pulse" Agent
nodes.title: Veeva "Cortex Pulse" Agent
nodes.description: Specialized agent bypassing Veeva Vault "Pull" bottlenecks via the Cortex Pulse micro-incremental crawling service. It monitors vault_audit_trails in 5-minute cycles, providing immediate awareness of eTMF and CTMS documents to the Cortex Central orchestrator.

nodes.label: Saama LSAC Dual-Path Broker
nodes.title: Saama LSAC Dual-Path Broker
nodes.description: Enforces the "Dual-Path Orchestration" architecture. It maintains a consistent sync with the Saama LSAC strategic data lake while simultaneously brokering tactical "Site-Nudge" actions via the Cortex Control Plane—bypassing lake latency for time-critical risk remediation.

nodes.label: Cortex IAM Guard
nodes.title: Cortex IAM Guard
nodes.description: Implements Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) and Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning for all agentic interactions. It verifies the identity and clearance levels of both human users and AI agents before allowing data flow.

nodes.label: Neural Cyber Sentinel
nodes.title: Neural Cyber Sentinel
nodes.description: Monitors the Cortex Bus for non-compliant signals or potential adversarial attacks. Uses behavioral analysis to detect anomalies in agent communication patterns and stops potentially harmful actions before they occur.

nodes.label: Enterprise MLOps & Scaling Architect
nodes.title: Enterprise MLOps & Scaling Architect
nodes.description: Responsible for the industrial-grade deployment and observability of the agentic swarm. It manages container orchestration, model load-balancing, and per-agent observability. It ensures that as the application scales from 1 trial to 500, the underlying cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud Run/GKE) remains performant and cost-optimized.

nodes.label: Agentic Scaling & LLMOps Engine
nodes.title: Agentic Scaling & LLMOps Engine
nodes.description: Deployment and scaling expert agent. Manages the lifecycle of thousands of clinical agents across Pfizer’s global cloud infrastructure. It optimizes vector store throughput, handles workload distribution, and monitors agentic behavior for security/performance drift in enterprise-grade environments.
